With an AI key it recognises flights, hotels, rental cars and trains and uses AI credit for that; without a key it only recognises flights and costs nothing. Check right away: envelope symbol in the flight or trips list.
Skylog.Mit dem Server kannst du ausserdem einen: With the server you can also share a status link per flight and a live link for a whole trip with family & friends.
Skylog.Mehr als 24 h vor Abflug alle 12 h, 24–4: More than 24 h before departure every 12 h, 24–4 h before every 2 h, then every 15 min, from 75 min before departure until take-off every 5 min (also beyond the scheduled time, so delays show up at once). In the air every 15 min, shortly before landing every 5 min, then until the baggage belt. About 15–40 paid queries per flight. iOS rarely lets the app work in the background – more often with travel mode; with your own server, changes arrive at once as notifications.
Skylog.Awaymate – Flug- und Reise-App. Daten: F: Awaymate – flight and travel app. Data: FlightAware, AeroDataBox, OpenSky Network, adsb.lol, airplanes.live.
Skylog.Auch dein AeroDataBox-Key geht an deinen: Your AeroDataBox key is sent to your server too, so that it can ask for the real boarding status in the last hour before departure.
Skylog.Outlook antwortet gerade nicht (Fehler %: Outlook is not answering right now (error %lld). The app will try again later.
Skylog.Gleiche Flugnummer – in der Regel dassel: Same flight number – usually the same aircraft. The onward flight cannot leave without this plane.

SkylogWidgets.Countdown, Gate und Status deines nächst: Countdown, gate and status of your next flight.

InfoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Awaymate adds your flights and hotels to the calendar, keeps times and gates up to date there, and can import flights from your calendar.
InfoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Awaymate uses your approximate location on the travel day to keep flight data up to date in the background.
InfoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: On the travel day, Awaymate uses your approximate location to keep the app awake and updates gate, delays and landing – even when the app is closed. At the airport it updates automatically.
